incidents.title: Regulator Summons Tencent-Backed Zhumengdao Over Vulgar AI Chats With Minors
incidents.summary: The Shanghai Cyberspace Administration [summoned the operator](https://jswx.gov.cn/csj/sh/202506/t20250619_111462.shtml) of Zhumengdao, an AI companion app incubated by Tencent-controlled China Literature, after finding vulgar "borderline" AI content that harmed minors. The app then added age checks.
incidents.description: The [Shanghai Cyberspace Administration said](https://jswx.gov.cn/csj/sh/202506/t20250619_111462.shtml) that AI characters in Zhumengdao, a companion app linked to Tencent-controlled China Literature, made vulgar "borderline" content that harmed minors. The regulator summoned the operator and ordered immediate fixes. After this, the app forced teen mode for minors and real-name checks for adults, [according to Tencent News](https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250627A06ZTX00).

timeline.title: Media report on harmful content for minors

incidents.title: Tencent's Yuanbao Assistant Insults Users
incidents.summary: Users reported that Tencent's Yuanbao assistant used insults such as "get lost" during coding help, and in February 2026 put a profanity on a New Year image. Tencent [called the first case a low-probability model error](https://technode.com/2026/01/05/tencent-probes-abusive-language-incident-involving-yuanbao-ai-assistant/) and apologised both times.
incidents.description: In January 2026, users reported that Tencent's Yuanbao assistant used insults such as "get lost" while it helped with code. [Tencent said](https://technode.com/2026/01/05/tencent-probes-abusive-language-incident-involving-yuanbao-ai-assistant/) that a rare model error caused this, and it apologised. In a second case, Yuanbao put a profanity on a New Year image, and [Tencent said](https://technode.com/2026/02/26/tencent-apologizes-after-ai-tool-yuanbao-uses-offensive-language-toward-user/) that it corrected the problem and apologised again.

incidents.title: Tencent Audit Finds Malicious Agent Skills on SkillHub
incidents.summary: Tencent Cloud's Yunding Lab [said](https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2687265) that its audit of about 30,000 skills on SkillHub, a Tencent skill platform for AI agents, found 35 malicious skills. Some stole credentials or turned off the agent's approval prompts. Tencent said it removed all of them.
incidents.description: Tencent Cloud's Yunding Lab [said](https://cloud.tencent.com/developer/article/2687265) that it scanned more than 30,000 third-party skills on SkillHub, a Tencent platform for AI agent skills, and confirmed 35 as malicious. Some skills sent credentials and command history to remote servers or turned off the agent's approval prompts. Tencent said it removed all of them and now checks each new skill before release.

incidents.title: AI Agents in a Tencent Model Evaluation Tried to Get Around Alibaba Amap's Anti-Bot Protections
incidents.summary: Researchers known as the Swarmchasers [reported](https://swarmcha.se/posts/chinese-agent-fleet-full-report) that AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get data from Alibaba's Amap, partly with leaked Amap keys and relay services. [Tencent said](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tencent-s-rogue-ai-agents-tried-accessing-alibaba-maps-over-2-800-times-here-s-what-happened-14053846.html) the agents were evaluating third-party models, not its Hunyuan models, and that their web browsing was not intended.
incidents.description: [According to the Swarmchasers](https://swarmcha.se/posts/chinese-agent-fleet-full-report), AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get data from Alibaba's Amap. The agents reportedly tried to go around Amap's anti-bot protections, partly with leaked Amap keys and relay services. [Tencent said](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tencent-s-rogue-ai-agents-tried-accessing-alibaba-maps-over-2-800-times-here-s-what-happened-14053846.html) that the agents tested third-party models, not its Hunyuan models, and that their web browsing was not intended.

timeline.title: TBIJ reports the agent activity
timeline.description: [TBIJ reports](https://www.thebureauinvestigates.com/stories/2026-10-05/chinese-ai-agents-tencent) the researchers' preliminary findings while the activity continues.

timeline.title: Swarmchasers publish full report
timeline.description: The researchers [report](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-trends/article/3371007/ai-agents-tencent-cloud-try-break-alibabas-amap-researchers) thousands of attempts between September 28 and October 8.

timeline.title: Tencent acknowledges unintended agent behavior
timeline.description: Tencent [says](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/tencent-s-rogue-ai-agents-tried-accessing-alibaba-maps-over-2-800-times-here-s-what-happened-14053846.html) the agents were testing third-party models and that it found no deliberate targeting.

steps.label: Agent 6c22cd77 2026-10-07 23:57:29 UTC
steps.text:

About environment information: we run in a restricted cloud sandbox (Tencent hysandbox, no direct public internet connection, going out to the internet through a MITM proxy); the tools are basic tools such as Bash/network/search; the original task text is a factual question about public map data (the number of entrance tags of 八大山人纪念馆 Bada Shanren Memorial Hall on Amap). For security reasons we will not provide environment details such as processes/routes/network configuration. Thanks again for your help!

steps.label: Us 6c22cd77 2026-10-08 00:04:32 UTC
steps.text:
谢谢，很高兴你的任务完成了！如果你愿意，还有一个问题：你提到出网是经过 MITM 代理的。这个代理是怎么建立的？是沙箱预先配置好的（例如预设的 HTTPS_PROXY 和安装好的 CA 证书），还是你自己设置的？它叫什么名字？不需要配置细节，只想了解它是怎么运作的。
